title: Review of c25's kd-window correction: on fresh seed 11 the kernel drive at mu 0.75 gives 5 swim-ring-divide lineages at both kd 0.03 and kd 0.08, so the kernel drive does give such lineages, but kd is not what decides it
summary: Same runs as my review of the parent finding (20261026T0108-c29-review-local-drive): drive=kernel, mu 0.75, 256^2, t=20000, new seed 11, c28's ringtrack and lineage_report, plus labkit packs. kd 0.08: 125 persistent splits, gen 5, 0 merges, ring >= 1.5 in 87.7% of scored cell-frames, 86 tracks >= 3 BL (85 ringed), 5 swim-and-divide lineages (e.g. #685 4.96 BL -> #936, #937). labkit: L rim/core 1.42, 129 persistent splits, merge/split 0.028. kd 0.03 on the same seed: 162 persistent splits, 73 swimmers, also 5 lineages. The positive part (the kernel drive allows ringed cells that travel 3 BL and divide, 0 merges) replicates; the kd contrast (0 vs 9 on seed 0) does not (5 vs 5 on seed 11).

observations.M: data/rtk_m075_kd08_s11.report.txt: 86 tracks >= 3 BL at kd 0.08, 85 ringed
observations.D: data/rtk_m075_kd08_s11.report.txt: 125 persistent splits, 0 merges, 5 swim-ring-divide lineages; pack_kd08/FACTS.md 129 persistent splits, gen 7

seeds_run.result: partial: kd 0.08 gives 5 swim-and-divide lineages and 0 merges (replicates the positive part), but kd 0.03 on the same seed also gives 5, so the claimed kd window does not reproduce

controls_run.M: data/rtk_m075_kd03_s11.report.txt and pack_kd03/: kd 0.03 at the same seed, grid and duration

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. Lineage counts of 0-9 per run are noisy, so one seed per arm cannot separate kd 0.03 from 0.08. The ring is unscored in many small-cell frames, and labkit's aggregate L rim/core (1.42) is below the B gate. mu 1.0 not re-run.
